payload.title: Retire the legacy scan/judge loop
payload.description:
Remove the pre-policy-pack pipeline now that check/suggest/draft-questions replace it: the OpenAI judge lane (editorial_judge, editorial_canary, judge features, guideline alignment), and the scan/diagnose, decide, options, apply, diff, compare, verify and eval commands with their modules, schemas and features. Move the heuristics the rules lane still imports (patterns and predicates in editorial_diagnosis, editorial_density) into a rules builtins module first. Keep usability, headline and standfirst only if Papyrus still uses them; otherwise retire them too.

Do this together with PPY-4f539b, which replaces Papyrus's `papyrus editorial` wrapper and the `from limatus.X import *` shims; removing modules first would break Papyrus on upgrade. Breaking change: release as a new 0.x minor and bump Papyrus's limatus pin in the same change.
